title: orch pull-requests ticket data: ext.pull-requests
description: Owned by the pull-requests add-on (its ticket_ext and ticket_fields; the add-on ships a byte-identical copy). merge_when_green = on: the add-on's background service puts the ticket's open, ready pull requests in the merge queue, which merges each only on green checks of the checked commit. pr, checks and merge are the live state of the ticket's newest open pull request, written by the add-on's refresh (read only). Not inert: merge_when_green starts merges.

merge_when_green.title: Merge when green
merge_when_green.description: on = merge this ticket's pull requests by themselves once every check passed. Absent or off = no.
